positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintain and develop new features for the Apcera cloud platform Web Console

- Work with modern container technologies (Docker, Kurma)
- Work with UX and product designers to turn mocks into working solutions
- Work as part of a team to develop and maintain a Mithril based SPA  
- Write JavaScript, HTML and CSS
- Integrate with RESTful APIs written in Go
- Support all major browsers

Apcera is disrupting the world of IT with the world’s first operating system for the Hybrid Cloud. With policy and governance built in at the core, the Apcera Hybrid Cloud OS lets IT teams and developers alike safely and easily develop, deploy, orchestrate and govern any imaginable workload — apps, services, Docker containers, operating systems — either on premise or in any cloud, public or private, all in a friction-free and trusted fashion. Companies of all sizes benefit from Apcera, with orders of magnitude increases in security, freedom and speed. 

Based in downtown SF and led by CEO Derek Collison, Apcera was initially funded by Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, and True Ventures among others, and recently received a very deep, nine-figure (USD) strategic investment from Ericsson, the global technology, cloud and mobile giant headquartered in Sweden.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed interactive video and second-screen products for leading media companies. Utilized cutting-edge HTML5 technologies and JavaScript frameworks.

- Used NodeJS/Express and Python/Tornado Web Server to develop server applications with RESTful APIs.

- Designed, implemented, and maintained JavaScript SDK used by major TV networks

- Assisted external development teams with SDK integrations

- Built plugins to enhance popular web video players with time-synced content

- Developed SPAs using jQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap, SASS, Compass, Bower, Yeoman, GruntJS, Gulp, Browserify, and WebPack

- Automated processes using GruntJS/GulpJS

- Practiced mobile-first and responsive design to deliver SPAs that worked across mobile and desktop. (iOS, Android, Mac, Windows)

- Optimized deployment strategy to create highly redundant and distributed single-page applications by using Amazon S3 and Cloudfront

- Worked on concurrent projects with tight deadlines and consistently delivered on schedule 

- Developed hybrid Android applications

- Mentored interns

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked closely with founder and domain-experts to design, implement and maintain applications for the foreclosure industry. Heavy use of the .NET stack (C#, ASP.NET MVC, MS SQL Server)

- Introduced modern approach to creating web applications using cutting-edge technologies like ASP.NET MVC, AJAX, jQuery, ORMs

- Extensive use of Google mapping technologies

- Maintained asset-management application built on the Microsoft Stack (C#, ASP.NET 2.0 - 4.0, MS SQL Server).

- Developed Android application for home inspections

- Built web-scrapers to automate the process of updating foreclosure listings

- Mentored intern

projects.title: Google Summer of Code - DBpedia
projects.description: Participated in the 2014 Google Summer of Code. I worked with members from the DBpedia organization to develop autosuggest plugins and embeddable widgets. I worked with jQuery, Angular, Python, Tornado Web Server, Redis, SPARQL, and the public DBpedia endpoints.
